summary: Scope PG&E persisted MFA/session state and in-memory HTTP sessions to the named setup, serialize each setup's MFA state machine, preserve account-discovery error classes, and honor REST request cancellation.
reason: Deep review found that multiple named PG&E/Opower setups shared a persisted state file and the global HTTP cookie jar, concurrent MFA calls could interleave mutable setup state, account discovery replaced authentication and transport errors with an empty-account error, and REST verification detached upstream work from request cancellation.
validated_outcome: Two named PG&E setups use independent persisted state and HTTP cookie jars; each setup serializes collection and MFA transitions; cancellation reaches REST verification; and account-discovery authentication failures remain classified for callers.
